stem:
Damini knows one angle of a rhombus is $55^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly finds the other three angles?

options.text: Report the words opposite angles as the three missing angle measures.
The other three angles are $55^{\circ}$, $55^{\circ}$, and $55^{\circ}$ because $55$ is the printed measure.
The opposite angle is $55^{\circ}$ and each adjacent angle is $125^{\circ}$.
Treat the rhombus as a rectangle and make all four angles $90^{\circ}$.

teacher.key_rationale: In a rhombus opposite angles are equal and adjacent angles are supplementary, so the angles are 55°, 125°, 55°, 125°. Naming the property alone is not the measures. Copying 55° four times ignores adjacency. Rectangle equal-90° rules are a different mechanism.
